title: Contrastive Metric Learning for Point Cloud Segmentation in Highly Granular Detectors
abstract: arXiv:2603.23356v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We propose a novel clustering approach for point-cloud segmentation based on supervised contrastive metric learning (CML). Rather than predicting cluster assignments or object-centric variables, the method learns a latent representation in which points belonging to the same object are embedded nearby while unrelated points are separated. Clusters are then reconstructed using a density-based readout in the learned metric space, decoupling representation learning from cluster formation and enabling flexible inference. The approach is evaluated on simulated data from a highly granular calorimeter, where the task is to separate highly overlapping particle showers represented as sets of calorimeter hits. A direct comparison with object condensation (OC) is performed using identical graph neural network backbones and equal latent dimensionality, isolating the effect of the learning objective. translated_title: 高粒度探测器中点云分割的对比度量学习
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种基于监督对比度量学习（CML）的新型点云分割聚类方法。该方法不预测聚类分配或以物体为中心的变量，而是学习一种潜在表示，使属于同一物体的点被嵌入在相近位置，而不相关的点则被分离开来。随后在学到的度量空间中，使用基于密度的读取方法重建聚类，从而将表示学习与聚类形成解耦，实现灵活的推理。该方法在高粒度量能器的模拟数据上进行了评估，任务是将表示为量能器击中点集合的高度重叠粒子簇射进行分离。在完全相同的图神经网络骨干网络和相同的潜在维度下，与物体凝聚方法（OC）进行了直接比较，从而隔离了学习目标本身的影响。CML方法产生了更稳定和（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种基于监督对比度量学习的点云分割新方法，通过学习使同物体点相近、异物体点分离的潜在表示并结合密度读取方法，在与物体凝聚方法相同的网络结构下实现了更优的高粒度量能器粒子簇射分离效果。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel point cloud segmentation method based on supervised contrastive metric learning, which learns a latent representation embedding same-object points nearby while separating unrelated ones, achieving more stable particle shower separation in highly granular calorimeters than object condensation under identical network architectures.
